claim_boundary: Twenty-seven author-coded participants and 928 depth-camera skeleton sequences across lunge, one-step-forward-lunge, and fleche actions, plus partially missing hand/foot IMU streams. The author-defined amateur, subelite, and elite labels are preserved, not independently validated. Participant codes are pseudonymized. Sensor segments are not asserted to align one-to-one with skeleton trials, and unusually long segments remain flagged rather than silently deleted. The source does not identify weapon, sex, age, handedness, or competition outcome and declares no license, so raw files and row-level derivatives stay local. Any model split must hold out complete participant groups.
